{"schema": "CREATE TABLE customers (customer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, email TEXT,
    region_code TEXT, signup_date TEXT, tier TEXT)
CREATE TABLE order_items (item_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, order_id INTEGER, product_id INTEGER,
    quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE orders (order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, order_ts TEXT,
    status INTEGER, channel TEXT, coupon_code TEXT)

    amount_twd INTEGER, paid_ts TEXT, payment_status TEXT)

    shipped_ts TEXT, delivered_ts TEXT)"}

{"thought": "customers 表有 signup_date 欄位，可視為註冊日期；直接用 SQL 計算 2025 年 3 月的不重複客戶數。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers, MIN(signup_date) AS min_signup, MAX(signup_date) AS max_signup, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2025-03-01' AND signup_date < '2025-04-01'"}}

response: {"thought": "查詢結果有 150 筆，但字串範圍比對可能漏掉非 ISO 格式的日期，先檢查 signup_date 格式是否一致。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS non_iso_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025-03-%') AS march_iso_rows FROM customers WHERE signup_date NOT GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' OR signup_date IS NULL"}}
